## Topics
- What makes data tidy
- The pipe
- filter(), select(), arrange(), mutate()
- group_by() + summarize(), count()
- Sanity-checking values (impossible ages)

## Learning objectives
By the end of this module you should be able to:

- Identify tidy vs. untidy data
- Chain dplyr verbs with the pipe
- Compute grouped summary statistics
